tour.q: Is this private, or will we join other guests?
tour.a: Most guests book privately. Small-group departures are possible on some dates. Tell us what you prefer when you enquire.

tour.q: How do pickup and drop work?
tour.a: We collect you from your hotel or home within Hyderabad city limits and bring you back. Other pickup points can be arranged.

cocurated.q: Can I book this on its own?
cocurated.a: Yes. Book it as a single experience or add it to a longer Asli Hyderabad itinerary.
It depends on the venue and the date. Tell us your numbers and we will confirm what works.
Yes. Add a chauffeur or transfer when you enquire and we will build it into your plan.

cocurated.q: How is the price worked out?
cocurated.a: Our team confirms the price for your date and group before anything is booked.

quick.q: Can you bring this to our venue?
quick.a: Yes, this is made for hotels, conferences, restaurants, corporate gatherings and private celebrations.

quick.q: How much space and set-up do you need?
quick.a: It varies by group size. Share your venue and headcount and we will send what we need.

quick.q: How much notice do you need?
quick.a: The more the better, especially in wedding and conference season. Tell us your date and we will check straight away.

quick.q: Can we combine more than one?
quick.a: Yes. Several experiences can run side by side or across an event.

original.q: Do I need to book in advance?
original.a: Yes. Originals run with limited places, so please book ahead.

original.q: Can I come on my own?
original.a: Yes. Originals are hosted so solo guests feel at home from the first minute.

original.q: Can you run a private edition?
original.a: Often, for groups. Tell us your date and numbers.

original.q: What if I have dietary needs?
original.a: Tell us when you book and we will plan around them.

service.q: How far ahead should I book?
service.a: A few days is usually enough, and sooner is better in peak season. We will always try for short-notice requests.

service.q: Can I add this to a tour or experience?
service.a: Yes. Mention it in your request and we will put everything into one plan.

service.q: How is the price worked out?
service.a: Our team confirms it for your date, duration and needs before anything is booked.

convention.q: Can you plan around my session times?
convention.a: Yes. Share your conference schedule and we will shape what fits between sessions.
No. Asli Hyderabad is independent of the organiser and curates experiences for visiting delegates.

convention.q: Can you pick me up from the venue?
convention.a: Yes. We can collect you from the convention venue or your hotel.

convention.q: Can you host a whole delegation?
convention.a: Yes, from a few colleagues to large groups. Tell us your numbers and dates.

contact.q: How soon will I hear back?
contact.a: We usually reply within one working day.

contact.q: Do you work with companies and conference organisers?
contact.a: Yes. We shape delegate programmes, incentive days and hosted experiences for groups.

contact.q: Is my request booked once I send it?
contact.a: No. It starts a conversation. Nothing is booked until our team has confirmed the details with you.

tours.p: Pick a tour as it stands, or tell us what to change.
Your date, pickup, pace and any food or access needs, confirmed by our team.
A local host and a comfortable car, from the first stop to your door.

cocurated.p: Fifteen ways in, made with the people and places that know them best.
Share your date and group, and we confirm the venue, timing and price.
Your host handles the rest. All you do is show up.

quick.p: Venue, date, headcount and the mood you are after.
Space, set-up, timing and performers, planned around you.
We arrive early, run it and leave the room as we found it.

originals.p: Each Original runs to its own calendar.
Places are limited. We confirm yours and share the details.
A host greets you, and the city does the rest.

services.p: One service or several, for one day or your whole stay.
Timing, people and price, all agreed before anything is booked.
One point of contact, from start to finish.

booking.p: It opens in WhatsApp, ready to send.
Usually within one working day, with options and a price.
Nothing is booked until you are happy with it.

access.p: Share who you would like to meet or see, and why it matters to you.
Each host decides personally. We share what you have told us.
Date, length, group size and any conditions the host sets.
An Asli host stays with you, and the conversation stays private.

logistics.p: Early starts, lunch-break tastes and evenings after the last talk.

logistics.h: From the door of the venue
logistics.p: We can collect you at the convention centre or your hotel and bring you back on time.
From a few colleagues to a full delegation, with hosts to match.
